name: Bitdefender
tagline: Consistently top AV-TEST scores with low system impact — best detection rate in the test
highlights: AV-TEST scores: 6/6 protection, 6/6 performance, 6/6 usability (2024 consumer tests)
Photon technology adapts scanning to your hardware to minimise slowdown
Romanian company; collects limited telemetry for cloud-based threat intelligence
verdict: The best overall antivirus — maximum detection, reasonable price, and low performance impact.
bestFor: Users who want the highest detection rates without noticeably slowing down their computer

name: Malwarebytes
tagline: Lightweight scanner that excels at removing existing infections
highlights: Among the lightest antivirus tools available — minimal CPU and RAM footprint
Specialises in removing adware, PUPs, and malware that traditional AV misses
Free version available for manual on-demand scanning
verdict: Best lightweight option — if you already have Windows Defender active, Malwarebytes adds useful cleanup capability.
bestFor: Users who want a lightweight second opinion scanner alongside Windows Defender

name: ESET NOD32
tagline: Best performance scores in the industry — extremely low system impact
highlights: AV-TEST top performance scores — lowest system impact of any commercial antivirus
Slovak company with a clear privacy policy and minimal telemetry collection
30+ years of threat intelligence built into the detection engine
verdict: Best for older or lower-spec hardware — excellent detection with virtually no performance overhead.
bestFor: Users with older computers or who run performance-intensive applications and need minimal overhead

name: Norton 360
tagline: Excellent detection rates with a comprehensive feature bundle — notable performance impact
highlights: Includes VPN, password manager, and dark web monitoring in the bundle
Strong AV-TEST detection scores: consistently above 99% in real-world tests
NortonLifeLock (now Gen Digital) has received regulatory scrutiny for data collection practices
verdict: Strong detection but overpriced, resource-heavy, and has a poor privacy track record compared to competitors.
bestFor: Users who want an all-in-one security bundle and are less concerned about resource usage

name: Windows Defender
tagline: Free, built-in, and surprisingly capable — the baseline all others are measured against
highlights: Free and already installed on every Windows PC — zero setup required
AV-TEST real-world protection score: 98.6% (2024) — better than many paid options
Deep Microsoft integration means it can patch exploits at the OS level
verdict: Surprisingly good for a free tool — adequate for cautious users, but add Malwarebytes for broader coverage.
bestFor: Budget-conscious users on Windows who practice safe browsing habits
